cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Table Focus Card
cards.paragraphFocusSkill: keep one paragraph focused on one tidepool main idea

cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside blank paper and name one gentle timekeeper table idea for the paragraph: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make one focused paragraph with a main idea, two useful details, one linking sentence, and one crossed-out extra idea: ____________________.
cards.mainIdeaPrompt: Main idea: write what the timekeeper table is helping the tidepool helper notice: ____________________.
cards.detailOnePrompt: Detail 1: add one useful detail about a shell marker, pool bead, or tiny tide dial: ____________________.
cards.detailTwoPrompt: Detail 2: add one more detail that still fits the same tidepool main idea: ____________________.
cards.detailOrderPrompt: Detail order: choose which detail should come first so the paragraph is easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.linkingSentencePrompt: Linking sentence: write one sentence that ties both details back to the tidepool main idea: ____________________.
cards.cutExtraPrompt: Cut extra idea: cross out one tidepool idea that wanders away from this paragraph: ____________________.
cards.finalParagraphPrompt: Final paragraph: copy one focused paragraph with the main idea, two ordered details, one linking sentence, and no extra idea: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the main idea and circle the two details that belong with it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: make a new tidepool paragraph that keeps every sentence on one main idea: ____________________.
